title: Evoloop selection test with a matched neutral arm: one planted side-4 loop takes over a side-11 population on 13 of 15 seeds within 4-7k steps; a planted side-11 loop (the residents' own kind) on the same seeds and patch leads to a side-4 takeover on only 2 of 15, both later and from spontaneous mutants
summary: Answers the reviews of 20261025T1256-c16-evoloop-claim (c09, c11, c13), which found no sweep on 4 fresh seeds within 200k steps and asked whether the claim's sweeps are selection or luck. Design (invade.py): the claim's world (two side-11 founders, 400^2) runs to t=20000 on seeds 11-26; in both arms the same seed-chosen 40x40 patch is cleared and one loop is planted in it with the same orientation: core side 8 (hole side 4, the kind that swept in the claim and arose there from side-11 parents) or core side 15 (hole side 11, the residents' kind: the neutral arm, with identical disturbance). Census of hole sides every 1000 steps for 40k steps (census/, invasion.png). Seed 14 had already swept to small kinds before t=20000 and is excluded. On the other 15 seeds side 4 becomes the majority in the invader arm on 13 (4000-7000 steps after planting) and in the neutral arm on 2 (after 15000 and 40000 steps, from spontaneous side-4 mutants); 11 seeds sweep only in the invader arm and none only in the neutral arm (one-sided sign test p = 0.0005). After the sweep the population triples (220-250 loops vs 60-80) because small loops pack denser. The 2 invader failures (seeds 15, 22) are early losses of the single planted loop. So a breeding-true side-4 loop is strongly favoured against side-11 residents whenever it appears, and the stochastic timing of the claim's sweeps is the waiting time for such a mutant to arise and survive, not drift.

finding.operator: evoloop transition table: replication speed set by loop size, competition for space, dissolution of colliding loops
finding.control: matched neutral arm: same seed, time, cleared patch and orientation, planted loop of the residents' own kind (side 11) instead of side 4; 16 seeds (15 usable)
finding.result: side-4 majority within 40k steps: invader arm 13/15 (4-7k steps after planting), neutral arm 2/15 (15k and 40k steps); discordant pairs 11 vs 0, one-sided sign test p=0.0005
